description: Solver-free v2: same frozen generator and decoder as v1, vectorised (bit-identical) candidate features and a LightGBM selector trained on 1,856 offline-labelled tasks. No physical solve at inference.

test.note: Fresh tasks sampled with sealed-registry and near-duplicate exclusion; labelled only after the selector was frozen.

latency_ms.scope: warm, raw task to one binary design
